cards.tldr: We present MEntA (Membership Entailment Attack), a query-efficient MIA that leverages natural-language entailment to maximize information gained per query. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has become central to large language model (LLM) deployments, grounding responses in enterprise or proprietary data to reduce hallucinations.

cards.title: Robustness of Question Answering Systems in the Biomedical Domain: a study of the BioASQ dataset
cards.authors: Andrew Reeves, Hang Dong
